prompt: What is the name of the town or city of birth of the player who won the men's singles at the US Open on the year after Venus & Serena Williams played each other for the 8th time as pros?
answer: The 8th professional meeting between Venus and Serena Williams was the **2002 French Open final**. The following year, **Andy Roddick** won the men’s singles title at the 2003 US Open. He was born in **Omaha, Nebraska**.
